actualMeaningExact: Ask what is already operating, who or what is covered, and what evidence would show it works.
mechanismExact: A proposal names a safeguard; a contract binds only participants and products inside its scope; a rollout changes what some accounts can encounter.
familiarExampleExact: A parent asks which exact AI product her school uses and whether its agreement includes the announced protections.
